cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll choose the glasses for our cafe. Just two to start; the rest can wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're still on the waiting list. I haven't even told Mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we won't buy anything. Show me the ones you'd put on our first table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those two. Mum would want a mug, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Find her one. I'll hold these until you've got it.

heightening.evidence: B4 supplies a possible customer with a different preference; A5 gives B the next hopeful selection while A helps.
